purpose: Resolve a conversation's effective context window and fill from backend-reported facts (loaded runtime window, remembered window, Modelfile num_ctx, architecture maximum, 8192 assumption) without ever setting num_ctx; plus the supporting wiring for the one capability 'know the window'.

public_api.name: resolveContextWindow
public_api.signature: resolveContextWindow(input: { runtime?: ModelRuntime; remembered?: number; modelMeta?: OllamaModelMeta }): ResolvedContextWindow
public_api.description: Pure. Precedence: loaded runtime window -> remembered (stale) -> Modelfile num_ctx -> <arch>.context_length (estimated) -> 8192 (assumed).

public_api.name: computeContextFill
public_api.signature: computeContextFill(steps: readonly Pick<ConversationStep,'kind'|'usage'>[], window: ResolvedContextWindow): ContextFill
public_api.description: Pure. Fill of the most recent step carrying usage; none-yet => zero fill; assistant response without usage => { unknown: true }.

public_api.name: recordRuntimeWindow
public_api.signature: recordRuntimeWindow(remembered: Record<string, number>, provider: string | undefined, model: string, resolved: ResolvedContextWindow): Record<string, number>
public_api.description: Pure. Returns the remembered-window record updated with a live (non-stale runtime) window; same reference when nothing changes.

public_api.name: ASSUMED_CONTEXT_WINDOW
public_api.description: Fallback window when nothing is known.

public_api.name: POST /models/runtime
public_api.signature: { model: string, provider?: string } -> { loaded: boolean, contextLength?: number }
public_api.description: Seam S-RUNTIME. Ollama: GET /api/ps only; non-Ollama: { loaded: false }.

public_api.name: contextPercent
public_api.description: shared/context-usage.ts; rounded integer percentage shared by meter and note.

public_api.name: SidebarState.rememberedContextWindows
public_api.signature: Record<string, number> keyed by modelIdentity(provider, model)
public_api.description: Persisted remembered runtime window; defaults merged on load.
